description: Defines the ArtifactDispatcher class which manages artifact-related operations such as saving, streaming, failure handling, cancellation, and deletion within the Playwright testing framework. It interacts with filesystem utilities and communicates with other dispatchers.

classes.name: ArtifactDispatcher
classes.description: A dispatcher class that handles artifact operations such as saving, streaming, failure reporting, cancellation, and deletion for artifacts in Playwright.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Creates an ArtifactDispatcher instance from a parent scope and artifact.

methods.name: fromNullable
methods.description: Creates an ArtifactDispatcher if the artifact is defined, otherwise returns undefined.

methods.name: pathAfterFinished
methods.description: Retrieves the path of the artifact after it has finished processing.

methods.name: saveAs
methods.description: Saves the artifact to a specified path.

methods.name: saveAsStream
methods.description: Provides a stream to save the artifact data.

methods.name: failure
methods.description: Retrieves failure information if the artifact has failed.
